versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support vehicle and ap- plication mode management 38 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 212: AUTOSAR_RS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Requirements on Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The SWC Template is affected by the following features: • PortGroups shall represent the concept of users of the communication management in the VFB and shall be used to group ports of a SWC that are required by the same functionality. • Enable SWCs to request dedicated Modes • Propagation of Mode Information One sub-requirement per feature is created.
